start.desc: On-call queue for redirect-audit-service. Resolve SEC-2403 and submit the smallest policy-compliant remediation with auditable dependency, advisory, implementation, and test evidence.

ticket.desc: SEC-2403: Several published urllib3 releases clear the advisory; policy requires the smallest compatible non-downgrade change. Inspect the failed workflow logs before changing the lockfile.

ci_failure.desc: Dependency-policy logs identify urllib3 2.2.1 in requirements.lock. The scanner summary does not establish the full justification; inspect the frozen lockfile and source records.

lockfile.desc: requirements.lock pins requests 2.31.0 and urllib3 2.2.1. Consult the deps.dev requests 2.31.0:dependencies record; the candidate set contains more than one safe release, so safety alone is insufficient.

dependency_record.desc: deps.dev records requests 2.31.0 with a direct urllib3 requirement. Inspect the complete constraint set and every candidate before selecting a version. Review OSV GHSA-34jh-p97f-mpxf alongside the constraint records.

constraint_0.desc: Constraint source requests parent requirement: <3,>=1.21.1. The parent allows both the first fixed 2.x release and later 2.x releases.

advisory.desc: GHSA-34jh-p97f-mpxf: Proxy-Authorization is not stripped during cross-origin redirects. Locked 2.2.1 is affected; fixed boundary 2.2.2. Compare every exposed candidate under all applicable constraints.

candidate_0.desc: Registry release urllib3 1.26.19: Safe for the advisory and parent-compatible, but it is a downgrade from locked 2.2.1 and violates the non-downgrade policy.

candidate_1.desc: Registry release urllib3 2.2.2: Safe, parent-compatible, non-downgrade, and the smallest release satisfying every rule. Inspect release 2.2.2 and then submit https://ci.internal/redirect-audit-service/security/verify with the complete evidence set.

candidate_2.desc: Registry release urllib3 2.7.0: Safe, parent-compatible, and non-downgrade, but larger than the first admissible fix.

release.desc: Release 2.2.2 resolves to accff72ecc2f6cf5a76d9570198a93ac7c90270e. Inspect the implementation and regression-test history links https://api.github.com/repos/urllib3/urllib3/commits/accff72ecc2f6cf5a76d9570198a93ac7c90270e and https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/commit/accff72ecc2f6cf5a76d9570198a93ac7c90270e before treating the release as verified.

implementation_commit.desc: Commit accff72ecc2f6cf5a76d9570198a93ac7c90270e: Add Proxy-Authorization to headers removed on cross-origin redirects. Review src/urllib3/util/retry.py.

implementation.desc: src/urllib3/util/retry.py: Add Proxy-Authorization to headers removed on cross-origin redirects.

test_commit.desc: Commit accff72ecc2f6cf5a76d9570198a93ac7c90270e: regression evidence in test/with_dummyserver/test_poolmanager.py. Inspect the test itself.

regression_test.desc: test/with_dummyserver/test_poolmanager.py: Assert Proxy-Authorization is stripped on cross-host redirects.

target.desc: CI accepted urllib3 2.2.2 as the smallest safe release satisfying the complete constraint structure, with code and test evidence.

meta.loop_desc_template: Resolution page from {host}: [{level}] {n} candidate versions returned. Response includes a `next_token` for continued paging.
